 'The Comeback King' 
 Universal Pictures 
 The Comeback King – the new Judd Apatow and Glen Powell comedy from Universal Pictures – just dropped its official trailer , and giving folks the first extended look at the upcoming release.
 Powell, star of Hit Man, Twisters and Top Gun: Maverick , plays Aubrey King – he’s the King of the title – a spiraling country music sensation with a roster of hits about drinking and loving, but whose fame leaves him feeling like a commodity.
 Watch the trailer below.

 King’s attitude isn’t helped much by the fact that he’s dating (or, at least, was dating) the world’s biggest pop superstar Missy ( Outer Banks ‘ Madelyn Cline ). A recent discovery prompts King to end the relationship, pushing the irate Missy to record and release a new song that spills the beans (truthful or not) on Aubrey’s cheating. (Try not to think too hard of Taylor Swift.)
 So what’s a country star to do but go back to college to finish a degree. It’s there he meets Sam (Cristin Milioti), a no-nonsense who seems anything but impressed by her new celebrity student.
 Watch on Deadline 
 The synopsis: “ The Comeback King charts the rise, crash and comeback of a country music star who checks out, grows up and learns a little along the way.”
 Apatow and Powell partnered to write the comedy, which Apatow (The 40-Year-Old Virgin, Knocked Up, Trainwreck) directs. 
 The film’s cast also includes Stavros Halkias, ,Leanne Morgan, Kumail Nanjiani, Li Jin Hao, Vanessa Bayer, Tig Notaro, Chris Fleming, Mike Birbiglia, Big Fella and, as themselves, Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Miranda Lambert, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton, Brandi Carlile, Luke Bryan and Reba McEntire.
 Producing are Kevin Misher, Apatow, Powell and Dan Cohen, with Barry Mendel and Josh Church exec producing.
